Due to geographical barriers, no direct access route exists between Facility Alpha and Facility Beta.
Furthermore, owing to simultaneous maintenance on alternative corridors, the inspection route must incorporate exactly one of the following two critical links: the access road between Facility Beta and Facility Gamma, or the access road between Facility Gamma and Facility Delta.

The objective is to determine the most efficient closed-circuit inspection tour, whereby the team visits every facility precisely once before returning to the initial point of departure, thereby minimizing the total distance traversed.
